blocks.text: Nation’s Girl Group BINI will officially unveil their newest single during the finale of their reality songwriting competition, “BINIverse and Chorus,” on Wednesday, November 25. Out of more than 300 demo submissions from songwriters across the country, only four tracks advanced to the final round. Moreover, the winning song will immediately become the P-pop group’s next official release.
